astro: Choose from the site’s actual dependencies and editing needs. This guide has no matched mainland benchmark that establishes a general speed advantage for Astro over WordPress. Compare the proposed request lists and the publishing workflow before choosing a platform.
speed: Set a target for the page and visitor action you need to support, then assess it against evidence with a named network, method and date. A first-byte result alone cannot establish whether that action finishes. Our guide on [hosting a website in China](/resources/china-web-guide/host-website-in-china/) covers the hosting decision.
